links.outcome: Report turnaround, wait, and read times for PE-positive CTPA exams
links.effect: Post-AI vs pre-AI: turnaround 47.6 vs 59.9 min (diff 12.3, 95% CI 0.6-26.0); wait 21.4 vs 33.4 min (diff 12.0); read time no difference (26.3 vs 26.5 min).
links.quote: For PE-positive examinations, the post-AI period, compared with the pre-AI period, had significantly shorter mean report turnaround time (47.6 vs 59.9 minutes; mean difference, 12.3 minutes [95% CI, 0.6-26.0 minutes]) and mean wait time (21.4 vs 33.4 minutes; mean difference, 12.0 minutes [95% CI, 0.9-25.3 minutes]) but no significant difference in mean read time (26.3 vs 26.5 minutes; mean difference, 0.2 minutes [95% CI, -2.8 to 3.2 minutes]).

screen.practice: AI-driven worklist reprioritization (triage) of positive studies
screen.reason: Evaluates the real clinical deployment of an AI triage tool integrated into radiology workflow to reprioritize reading worklists for positive pulmonary embolism CTPA scans, comparing turnaround times before and after implementation.
